phase_name: Canonical Human Governance Record Schema and Artifact Foundation Implementation
summary: Implemented the CHGR machine-verifiable schema/artifact foundation only (representation, validation, packaging, inspection, verification) per CHGR-001 v1.0 and the Phase 143D implementation plan, narrowed per this phase's own governing prompt to exclude interactive decision workflow, confirmation UX, and any create/confirm/publish/suspend/supersede/revoke/import command, and no .pcae/governance-records/ storage or registry. Delivered a six-type schema family (DecisionTemplate, HumanGovernanceRecord, HumanConfirmationEvidence, GovernanceRecordProvenance, GovernanceRecordIntegrity, GovernanceRecordLifecycleEvent) under src/pcae/schema_resources/chgr/ reusing schema_runtime unchanged; a pcae.governance library package (inspection.py, verification.py) mirroring pcae.cltr.authority_inspection's read-only, explicit-artifact pipeline; a new pcae governance-record {inspect,verify,template inspect} CLI (new top-level noun, since pcae governance was already taken by an unrelated repo-governance-coherence auditor); 32 synthetic fixtures; and six new test files (110 tests passing). All eight CHGR-001 section 13.1 lifecycle states are implemented, per section 13.4's own explicit resolution of a seven-vs-eight-state prompt discrepancy. NB-1 and NB-2 remain carried forward, unrepaired, from Phase 143D. No governance contract was modified; the existing GPC6-REQ-075(b) election remains byte-identical and was never used as a fixture. See docs/PHASE_143E_CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_SCHEMA_AND_ARTIFACT_FOUNDATION_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
